title: Famous rugby players and the country they represent

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?cLabel) AS ?rawTeam) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?team) AS ?nTeam) WHERE { ?item wdt:P106 wd:Q14089670 ; wdt:P54 ?team ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . ?team wdt:P31 wd:Q58840819 . ?team rdfs:label ?cLabel . FILTER(lang(?cLabel)="en") FILTER(?sitelinks > 5) FILTER(!CONTAINS(?cLabel, "amateur") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "schoolboy") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "President's XV") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "Club XV") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "Universities") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "lympic") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, " at the ") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "squad") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, " B ") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "U19") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "U20") && !CONTAINS(?cLabel, "U21")) } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 1500 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nTeam = 1) BIND(REPLACE(?rawTeam, " (men.s |women.s )?national rugby union team$", "") AS ?countryLabel) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 459
